name: Ookii Onna no Ko ni Hakobareru!
original_name: 大きい女の子に運ばれる!
source:
The four main characters, Ichika, Shinome, and Rena, are trapped in another world that resembles a school by chance. Moreover, the main character is minimized and naked for some reason.

I can't run with a small stride. On top of that, Ichika, who can't see the protagonist freezing in the cold, "can't help it" and offers to explore while holding the protagonist...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ389725.html]DL Site[/url]]
translation:
主角一花、四目、丽奈四人偶然被困在了类似学校的异世界。而且，由于某种原因，主角被最小化并赤身裸体。

我无法小步跑。除此之外，看不到主角被冻僵的一香“忍不住”，主动提出抱着主角去探索……
